---
title: "Data Analytics Careers in Financial Services"
---

## Research and product question

What skills, experience levels, salary opportunities, and employment patterns should aspiring Data Analysts understand when pursuing careers in financial services (NAICS 523), and how can job seekers use these factors to evaluate their career readiness and identify areas for upskilling?

NAICS 2022: 523

Target career pathway: Data Analyst / Data Analytics

https://www.naics.com/naics-code-description/?code=523
 
Industry label: Securities, Commodity Contracts, and Other Financial Investments and Related Activities

This industry includes organizations involved in securities, investments, financial markets, and related financial activities. It provides a useful setting for evaluating Data Analyst careers because the dataset contains analytics-related positions that can be analyzed across salary, required skills, experience, location, and other career factors.
